name: demo_counter
about: Smallest possible mod: counts calls of one stock mixer helper. It exists to exercise the tools. It changes no sound and adds no interface.

hooks.about: stock mixer helper in ITCM, same bytes on every base

not_pointers.why: DOOM OS 0.7.3 only: an increasing table of integers (... 80279, 85049, 90103, 95457 ...), not an address

hooks.about: the same site on DOOM OS 0.7.4, where DOOM's table of integers has moved

not_pointers.why: DOOM OS 0.7.4: the same increasing table of integers as 0x60377440 on 0.7.3, moved with DOOM's own code (63726 ... 90103, 95457 ..., read 2026-11-23), not an address
